text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: GPU pool 'eu-west-3' reporting sustained queue growth and throttling. Estimated 90% queue backlog for model-lg-high. Auto-scaler attempted add but hit scale_limit. Paging oncall.

oncall-anna: I'm on it. seeing queue length spike ~08:12 UTC, token TPS doubled. Any deployments around that time?

deploy-bot: deploy finished: infra-service v2.14.3 at 08:08 UTC by eng_ash (sha: a1b2c3). No model changes recorded.

eng_ash: I rolled infra-service traffic config; only change was a tweak to continuous batching heuristic (window_ms from 8 -> 12) to reduce fragmenting. didn't touch cache code.

sre_jules: suspect continuous batching tweak may be enlarging batch windows and causing head-of-line waits + KV prefix cache thrashing. seeing increased prefix cache miss rate from 3% -> 38% at 08:10.

infra-max: confirming: KV cache evictions spiked, kvcache metrics show hot keys getting evicted repeatedly. prefix_cache_ttl appears lower on newly rolled hosts (ttl: 60s vs expected 600s).

oncall-anna: wait, why did TTL change? config rollout? show the config diff

eng_ash: checking... oh. there's a config override in the infra-service release that set prefix_cache_ttl to 60 for the 'fast-path' optimization. I thought it was only for a debug flag but it propagated to prod pools. oof.

sre_jules: that's the smoking gun. prefix cache TTL drop + larger batch windows = cache churn + longer per-request batching delays -> throughput collapse. Autoscaler sees long latency and queues more requests but scale cap prevents adding required GPUs.

ryan-proxy: adding datapoint: we started returning 429s for tail requests at 08:13. Affected customers: multiple mid-market tenants on eu-west-3. CS alerted.

cs_lee: getting initial reports: one customer (acme-inc) seeing 30% error rate for inference calls since ~08:15. They're now on a support call.

oncall-anna: mitigation plan:
1) revert prefix_cache_ttl override on infra-service (rollback to 600s) -> config change
2) temporarily reduce continuous batching window back to 8ms
3) bump autoscaler pool cap from 12 -> 18 for eu-west-3 (short window) and enable immediate scale_out
4) monitor queue length + 95p latency

sre_jules: +1. I'll run the rollback and change TTL via k8s configmap patch. infra-max can trigger autoscaler cap bump.

eng_ash: pushing rollback now. command:
```
kubectl set env deploy/infra-service PREFIX_CACHE_TTL=600 -n prod-eu-west-3
kubectl rollout restart deploy/infra-service -n prod-eu-west-3
```

deploy-bot: rollout started for infra-service in prod-eu-west-3 (revision v2.14.3-rollback) at 08:18 UTC.

infra-max: bumping autoscaler cap and forcing scale out:
```
infractl set-autoscaler --region eu-west-3 --pool gpu-large --max 18
infractl scale --pool gpu-large --count 16 --region eu-west-3 --instant
```

sre_jules: changed continuous batching param back via feature flag:
```
PATCH /api/featureflags/continuous_batching
{ "window_ms": 8 }
```

oncall-anna: early metrics: prefix cache miss rate falling (now 12%), kvcache evictions trending down. queue length dropping from 92% backlog -> 40% in 5m.

ryan-proxy: 429s decreased sharply. tail latency 95p improving. still seeing some queued requests finishing slowly.

cs_lee: pinging acme-inc with ETA and mitigation summary. they'll keep us posted on errors.

sre_jules: keep an eye on autoscaler. if we overscaled, we'll drain extras after stabilization. also audit other regions for same config override.

eng_ash: huge apology. the flag leak happened because the debug override was accidentally included in the manifest. will open a PR to add safeguards to release pipeline.

oncall-anna: status update at 08:34 UTC: mitigation in progress, customer impact reduced. moving to monitoring -> post-incident actions. tagging follow-ups: eng_ash to fix release pipeline; infra-max to add autoscaler emergency escalation runbook; cs_lee to compile impacted customer list and notify account teams.

incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated; severity: high -> partial. create postmortem? :white_check_mark:

sre_jules: I'll create a postmortem draft and link metrics + grafana panels. notes: root cause = config override (prefix_cache_ttl lowered) + continuous batching change + autoscaler scale_limit. Secondary: lack of preflight checks for config overrides and missing emergency scale escalation.

cs_lee: acme-inc confirms errors dropped to <1% after 08:28. closing customer impact window 08:15-08:28 UTC. will follow up with formal incident email.

oncall-anna: thanks all. handing back to ops rotation. i'll update the oncall log.

eng_ash: follow-up PR created: #4521 - prevent debug flags leaking to prod manifests. tagging sre_jules for review.

sre_jules: 👍 monitoring for 1h, then postmortem and change proposals. good work on fast rollback.
